The carbon fibers have an average diameter of 7 μm and contain several small grooves on the surface.
The XRD analysis indicates that the carbon fibers have a non-graphitized carbonaceous structure.
The real part of the complex permittivity of polyurethane is less than 2.8, indicating weak reflection of microwaves.
As the carbon fiber content increases from 0.03 wt% to 0.1 wt%, the maximum absorbing peak moves from the Ku-band to the C-band.
With a matching thickness of 2.5 mm, the minimum reflectivity of the double-layer CFPURAC reaches -41 dB, and the effective absorbing bandwidth (reflectivity < -10 dB) is 8.6-18 GHz.
For the four-layer CFPURAC, the effective absorption bandwidth reaches 13.1 GHz in the optimal configuration.
The effective absorbing frequency range of the four-layer CFPURAC is 4.9 GHz to 18 GHz.
